findings.title: Cancel saves valid provisional quantity and updates persisted totals
findings.expected: UI-1 requires Cancel to discard edits without an update request or persisted changes; reopening must show the saved value.
findings.actual: Alice saved 3; editing to 4 and clicking Cancel sent PUT 200 and GET 200, showed quantity 4 / total 48 with Cart updated, and persisted across reload. Narrow keyboard Cancel changed 4 to 2 in a second reproduction.
findings.impact: A user's discarded edit is committed, changing cart quantities and totals without selecting Save.

risks.area: Async identity switching and pending saves
risks.reason: Shared current state is written by refresh without response-generation checks; async races not exercised.
risks.next_probe: Delay an Alice refresh/save, switch to Bob, and verify displayed and persisted identity consistency.

risks.reason: Narrow Tab-to-Cancel was exercised but complete keyboard Save and backend error recovery were not.
risks.next_probe: Use keyboard-only Save at desktop/narrow sizes; provoke a visible failure and recover.

risks.reason: Removal is irreversible through the available update API; kept fixture recoverable.

risks.reason: Bob API state was verified unchanged, but Bob UI switching and mutation were not exercised.
